# sca approve

[← Command reference](../commands.md)

`<sca_options>` are the [global options](../commands.md#global-options).

```text
The approve command help

Used by an authority for issuing new certificate and creating it's certificate
bundle archive. Encapsulates several document creation and exporting
operations.
```

**Syntax**

```text
sca [<sca_options>] approve [<approve_options>] <entity> [<entity_id>]

approve_options:

  -h, --help      - optional. if used the operation is completed by presenting
                    this help.
  -f, --force     - optional. if an existing certificate, pub or pub_ssh file
                    exists, back it up and generate a new one.
  -s, --sign-by   - optional. if used, specifies the entity to use for signing
                    on the issued certificate. valid values are the ids of the
                    existing entities with certificates capable of signing
                    other certificates. normally, those are ca and subca ids.

allowed values for the entity are:

  - ca            - for current certificate authority
  - subca         - for current sub-ordinate certificate authority
  - user          - for current user
  - host          - for current host
  - service       - for current service

entity_id is the id of the entity requested to approve.
```

Approving requires access to the CA or sub-CA key. When using a YubiKey, this will prompt for the PIN.
